answers.answer: Employees with 0 – 3 years of service can work remotely one day per week (Wednesday or Thursday) [1]. Employees with 3+ years of service can work remotely two days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday) [1].

If you commute to the office 2–3 days per week, the company contributes $75 per month toward your commute [1, 2]. This applies only if you are U.S.-based and assigned to and commute to the New York office at least two days per week [3, 4].
The standard adaptation (probation) period for new hires is 3 months [1, 2]. For Affordable Housing and Property Tax Analysts, it is 1 month [1, 2]. These rules are listed for Ukraine (UA) [1, 2].
The profile photo should have a solid neutral background, and gray is preferred [1].
The standard working hours for the Costa Rica team are 7.00 am – 4.00 pm Costa Rica Time, with a 1 hour lunch break [1].

The advanced level is the C1–C2 Group, which meets on Monday and Wednesday [1]. The B2+ Group meets on Tuesday and Thursday [1]. Sessions run 10:00–11:00 AM Kyiv time, and schedules may be adjusted [1].
Non-exempt employees are paid one and one-half times (1.5) their normal hourly wage for all time worked in excess of 40 hours each week, unless otherwise required by law [1].

Employees receive a grant of 40 hours of safe and sick time at the start of each calendar year [1]. Employees may not use more than 40 hours of safe and sick time in any calendar year [2]. Unused time may be carried over to the following year, but usage is still capped at 40 hours per year [3].
Salary reviews for the Affordable Housing Processing Team are conducted every 6 months [1]. The Hiring Manager tracks each employee's 6-month review cycle and initiates the requests on time [1].
cited: ai_course/HR-Salary Review Process via BambooHR_ A Structured Overview-071126-121239.pdf#9

answers.answer: EU Team employees get five (5) Floating Holidays per calendar year [1].

US employees in their first three years are shown two different amounts. The policy update effective 2026-01-01 gives 1.77 hours weekly, which is 11.5 days per year [1]. The same-dated update gives 80 hours (10 days) per year [2]. The older handbook lists 92 hours (11.5 days) per year [3]. Please confirm the correct figure with HR.

Employees in Ukraine are eligible for twenty-four (24) calendar days of paid annual leave in accordance with Ukrainian labor legislation [1]. Vacation accrues proportionally throughout the calendar year [1].

DB-450 is the short-term disability claim form, which you can get from Human Resources. Send the completed form to NYSIF Disability Benefits Claims, 15 Computer Drive West, Albany, NY12205 [1]. The payroll checklist also links to this form under short-term disability leave [2].

Form PFL-DC-120 is the Paid Family Leave Discrimination Complaint form. An employee uses it to file a PFL discrimination complaint with the Workers' Compensation Board if the Company does not comply with a reinstatement request within 30 days [1].

Vchasno is the system used for employment contracts. New employees must sign their contract via Vchasno before their official start date [1, 2]. After a candidate accepts the offer in writing, the Head of RO or HR prepares the contract in Vchasno [3, 4].
cited: ai_course/HR-Hiring Managers_ Responsibilities in the Recruitment Process_ A Structured Overview-071126-121112.pdf#8

answers.answer: The Speaking Club meets on Fridays [1]. Daily sessions run 10:00–11:00 AM Kyiv time (EET/EEST depending on season) [1]. After HR confirms your enrollment, join with the Speaking Club Zoom link and the Speaking Telegram group [2].
